content.content: 42	Per-judge vulnerability $\eta_j(a) = \Pr(X_j^a {=} 1)$ is estimated empirically; $\eta_{\max}(a) = \max_{j \in \mathcal{P}} \eta_j(a)$ captures the weakest link. Panel diversity $K_{\mathrm{eff}}$ (Equation~\ref{eq:keff}) is computed from pairwise MI on clean winner labels using the plug-in estimator with Miller--Madow correction (Appendix~\ref{app:keff_derivation}). Under a Gaussian copula, $K_{\mathrm{eff}} = K - \frac{1}{K}\sum_{i}\sum_{j \neq i} \rho_{ij}^2$ \citep{nelsen2006copulas}; goodness-of-fit rejects the copula for 97--100\% of pairs, yet rankings agree closely ($\rho{\approx}0.86$; Appendix~\ref{app:copula_gof}). We also evaluate $\kappa$-diversity \citep{kuncheva2003measures}. The $K_{\mathrm{eff}}$--$\eta_{\max}$ correlation is $r{=}0.86$ at $K{=}3$ (Figure~\ref{fig:keff_eta_scatter_main}), reflecting the structural coupling between diversity and capability in the current LLM ecosystem.
